name: Ink Of Chtulhu (Minor Artifact)
body:
Slot none; CL 20th; Weight 8 lb./gallon; Aura strong conjuration

DESCRIPTION

This sickly green, phosphorescent ichor from a submersed ancient god has many uses. It is a powerful ingredient for many evil occult rituals. Pure or diluted in other liquids and drunk, it grants an evil creature the horrific glimpse ability of a shaman with the Dark Tapestry spirit for 1 day. If used to bathe the body, it grants 1 mythic tier or rank to an evil user. If used as writing or painting ink or applied as a poison on a weapon, it has the effect of a sinspawn‘s sinful bite on a creature that watches the picture, reads the writing, or is hit by the weapon. Finally, if used to draw tattoos on a creature’s body, it confers a profane bonus on Armor Class equal to the higher among that creature’s Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma scores.

DESTRUCTION

Drinking the liquid or bathing in it destroys it. If used as writing, painting, or tattoo ink, it is destroyed when the painted/inscribed item or the tattooed creature is destroyed. If applied to a weapon, it is consumed when the weapon strikes a creature or is touched by the wielder.
